content:
Sophia used 4 gallons of gas to drive 100 miles. To find her car's fuel efficiency, we calculate miles per gallon:

\[
\text{Miles per gallon} = \frac{100 \text{ miles}}{4 \text{ gallons}} = 25 \text{ miles per gallon}
\]

Her gas tank holds 12 gallons. The total distance she can drive on a full tank is:

\[
\text{Total miles} = 25 \text{ miles/gallon} \times 12 \text{ gallons} = 300 \text{ miles}
\]

Answer: 300 miles
